annotations.title: Get Robot Impact Score for a Profession

description: Get the Geppetto Robot Impact Score (0-100) for any profession. Composite of task-automation research (35%, the Oxford Frey and Osborne score), IFR robot deployment (30%), an academic-consensus score (20%, the average of the Oxford score and the OECD risk band), and robot density (15%). The O*NET-SOC code is a cross-reference only, not a scoring input. Higher means more automation pressure on the occupation.

profession_slug.description: Profession slug e.g. warehouse-picker-packer, nurse-routine-monitoring, delivery-driver-last-mile, long-haul-truck-driver
